label: Synthetic MSSP-style shared-savings demonstration
track: BASIC level E style terms, one-sided for this demonstration
population_rule: Members with a member_month row for payer WH-PAYER-MSSP in the performance year (Medicare FFS and dual FFS). Expenditure is payer_claim.paid_cents on that payer's claims with counts_in_metrics = 1, by year of service_from, divided by the same members' MSSP member months.
assumptions: Every benchmark, rate and the quality result in this file is an authored demonstration assumption, not a CMS benchmark, an executed agreement or a measured quality score.
A real MSSP agreement requires at least 5,000 assigned beneficiaries; this synthetic population has about 210. The figures show the arithmetic, not a plausible settlement.

The benchmark is a flat dollar PMPM per year. CMS benchmarks are risk-adjusted, trended and regionally blended, and expenditures are truncated and completed for claims run-out; none of that is applied here.

Shared savings = (benchmark PMPM - actual PMPM) x member months x sharing rate, paid only when savings reach the minimum savings rate and the quality standard is met. No losses are shared (one-sided).
